text:
alex: Quick RFC follow-up: propose compact decision payload and safe fallback drain semantics for auto-rollbacks. Need quick feedback so runbook can land.

renee: Compact payload yes. Suggest flat keys only (no nested JSON). Include decision_id, service, route, trigger_ts, evaluated_at, ttl_s, action (switch|drain|noop), target_model, provenance, decision_state, attempt, trace_id, request_hash.

chung: For provenance encode as: detector:det-23|ver:2|pids:abc,def. Easier to query and avoids schema churn.

alex: Agreed. Decision states: proposed -> executing -> completed | aborted. Add decision_attempt for retries and decision_ttl to ignore stale.

renee: Drain semantics: default graceful_drain_seconds per-service (configurable). If warmup tail exists allow extend by API: POST /internal/decisions/{id}/extend {extend_seconds}. Ops runbook should show how to call it.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary policy applied to staging: graceful_drain_seconds=120.

chung: Telemetry metric names: fallback.decisions.count, fallback.decisions.state_change, fallback.triggers.reason, fallback.latency_p95_ms, fallback.model_quality.delta. Use dots for consistency.

renee: Alert: page infra when decisions aborted > 2 in 15m. Low-severity alert if triggers spike without action.

alex: Manual trigger snippet for ops in runbook: 
```bash
# manual fallback switch
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"service":"api","route":"/v1/generate","action":"switch","target_model":"model-2026-03-20"}' \
  https://ops-api.internal.redwood/internal/v1/fallbacks/decision
```

chung: Important: include trace_id and trace_url (if present) in decision event for fast correlation. Do NOT include raw request body.

renee: Also: Decision API must return canonical decision_id and evaluated_at timestamp and be idempotent by decision_id.

alex: I'll draft the runbook with these fields and examples and add the curl examples. Pls comment on PR when it's up. Thanks :thumbsup:
